newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Sidmar drops Polish JV plan.
newsitem.headline: Sidmar drops Polish JV plan.

text.p: Belgian steel maker Sidmar NV, a unit of Luxembourg's Arbed group, said in a statement on Monday it had dropped plans to set up a joint venture company with Poland's Huta Katowice SA.
"After an extensive fact finding and evaluation of the project, the partners have decided to terminate the preparatory studies for the establishment of the joint venture," Sidmar said.
The two companies said last year they were studying plans to build a thin slab caster and hot rolling mill.

Sidmar said Huta Katowice would, however, study further the setting up and operation of a thin slab caster and hot rolling mill within its core steel division Linea Stali, taking advantage of Huta Katowice's excess capacity of liquid steel.
The Belgian and Polish companies would also continue working together to improve Huta Katowice's steel production with the help of Sidmar's know-how.
